claim: Reminders that can never be sent because sendTo is missing or the message is empty (line 158), or because workflowStep/booking is null (line 68), never get retryCount incremented, so they are still re-queried and skipped every cron run until their date passes — the exact behaviour the PR aims to stop.

The new `retryCount > 1` OR-branch in deleteMany has no `method: SMS` filter, so the SMS cron deletes EMAIL/WHATSAPP reminders with retryCount > 1 and the branch cannot use the (method, scheduled, scheduledDate) index.

Transient failures (Twilio 5xx/network errors, a temporary SMS lock where scheduleSMS returns undefined) are counted the same as permanent ones, so a ~30 minute outage (two 15-min cron runs) permanently deletes every pending SMS reminder in the 7-day window.

The prisma.update inside the catch block is unguarded; if it throws (e.g. P2025 because the reminder was deleted by a concurrent booking cancellation), the error escapes the for-loop and aborts processing of all remaining reminders in that run.
